_notes: Derives item rarity from a balance asset name. The Gibbed dumps expose no rarity field.
Rules are checked IN ORDER: the most specific first (VeryRare before Rare, path markers before suffixes).
Anything unmatched is Rarity::Unknown: the UI shows a neutral diamond and the text 'Unknown'.
overrides pin exact balance names (unique legendaries) to a rarity; add them as they are identified.
